premises.text: Male fertility has declined significantly and infertility affects many couples
premises.evidence_span: over the past 40 years, male fertility has halved. And in fact, infertility affects about one in seven couples globally

premises.text: The burden of infertility is often on men as well as women
premises.evidence_span: 30 to 50% of the time when a couple can't have a child, the burden falls on the man

premises.text: Men face various risk factors that can affect sperm quality
premises.evidence_span: pollution, drinking, smoking, drugs, obesity, sexually transmitted diseases

premises.text: Current sperm testing and freezing experiences are awkward and clinical
premises.evidence_span: the experience today is so awkward and clinical of going to a clinic to do it

premises.text: Legacy provides a consumer-focused experience for sperm testing and freezing
premises.evidence_span: Legacy is the first company focused on the consumer experience of testing and then freezing men's most valuable assets

premises.text: The product includes discreet packaging and personalized information
premises.evidence_span: they receive an envelope with handwritten information that is relevant to them as well as a unique client ID

premises.text: The process includes a post-thaw motility check to ensure sample viability
premises.evidence_span: we do what's called a post-thaw motility check to make sure that the sample is still viable and can be used in the future

premises.text: There is a significant addressable market for men's fertility services
premises.evidence_span: we believe there's an addressable market of about $8 billion in the U.S. alone

premises.text: Companies offering fertility benefits should consider Legacy as a client
premises.evidence_span: 250 companies in the United States offer fertility benefits to their employees, focused largely on IVF and egg freezing

premises.text: Legacy's product is significantly cheaper than egg freezing
premises.evidence_span: compared to the $10,000 price tag of egg freezing, our product is 10% of that cost

premises.text: Legacy is testing two business models for its services
premises.evidence_span: we're testing two business models, one fertility and analysis and freezing bundled, the other unbundled

value.text: Men can test and freeze their sperm in a discreet and consumer-friendly manner
value.evidence_span: designed to look and feel a very particular way
